info.title: Drools Document Intelligence API
info.description:
AI-powered Document Processing API for:

    - Invoice Data Extraction
    - Purchase Order (PO) Retrieval
    - Goods Receipt Note (GRN) Retrieval
    - Invoice vs PO vs GRN Matching
    - OCR using Claude Vision
    - Structured Data Extraction using AWS Bedrock

    The API processes uploaded invoice documents, extracts structured information,
    retrieves corresponding SAP PO and GRN data, and performs automated document matching.

get.summary: List pipeline status of processed documents
get.description: Returns a paginated list of documents whose extraction has reached a terminal state. Rows still In Progress (or with no tracked pipeline_execution_status) are excluded. Each row carries a two-level status: `status` (Success / Failed) and `root_cause` (stage detail such as 'extraction successful', 'matching successful', or a raw matching failure code like PO_NOT_FOUND). Optional `filter` (all / green / red) narrows the list by derived status. Newest first.

parameters.name: filter

schema.description: UI status filter. 'all' applies no status filter; 'green' keeps only documents whose derived status is Success; 'red' keeps only those whose derived status is Failed. The value is normalized and converted to an internal status token (None / 'Success' / 'Failed') by the validators.

Use it to render a pager without fetching a page.

get.summary: List distinct vendor names from processed invoices
get.description: Returns the distinct supplier (vendor) names extracted from processed invoices, sorted case-insensitively A->Z. Optional `start_date` / `end_date` (IST calendar dates, YYYY-MM-DD) narrow the list to invoices processed within that window (both bounds independent and optional; the end day is fully included). With no dates, all vendors are returned.

get.summary: Presigned S3 URL for an invoice's source file
get.description: Returns a time-limited presigned GET URL for the S3 object of the invoice identified by `invoice_id` (InvoiceData PK). Optional `expires_in_hours` sets validity (default 24, max 168). 404 if the id does not exist. Note: object existence is not verified, and under temporary credentials the URL cannot outlive the session token.

parameters.name: invoice_id

schema.description: InvoiceData primary key of the invoice whose file to sign
schema.title: Invoice Id

parameters.description: InvoiceData primary key of the invoice whose file to sign

parameters.name: expires_in_hours

schema.description: Requested validity of the presigned URL, in hours. Default 24 (1 day); max 168 (7 days, the S3 SigV4 ceiling). NOTE: under temporary credentials (e.g. an ECS task role) the URL cannot outlive the underlying session token regardless of this value.
schema.title: Expires In Hours

parameters.description: Requested validity of the presigned URL, in hours. Default 24 (1 day); max 168 (7 days, the S3 SigV4 ceiling). NOTE: under temporary credentials (e.g. an ECS task role) the URL cannot outlive the underlying session token regardless of this value.
